name: colab-runner
description: Run safe, observable workloads on Google Colab through the official CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Safe, observable Colab jobs from Codex
interface.longDescription: Provision a fresh Google Colab runtime through Google's official CLI, execute a bounded Python workload, retrieve declared artifacts, export a replayable notebook log, and release the session automatically.
defaultPrompt: Run this Python workload safely on Colab and retrieve its artifacts.
Check my active Colab sessions and report anything still consuming compute.
Execute this notebook on a T4 with a hard deadline and export the run log.
